## What it does

DefiLlama gateway over x402: read protocol TVL and metadata, multi-chain current & historical token prices with charts, and DeFi pool yields/APY — through one provider with TRON, BSC and Base Mainnet payment routes.


## Best for

- Agents doing DeFi research, allocation and risk screening that need TVL and protocol metadata.
- Pricing and valuation workflows that need multi-chain current and historical token prices.
- Yield scouting across pools by APY, TVL and risk.

## Endpoints

- `GET /protocols` — All protocols with current TVL, category and chain breakdown
- `GET /protocol/{slug}` — Single protocol: historical TVL, tokens, metadata
- `GET /tvl/{protocol}` — Current total TVL of a protocol (lightweight)
- `GET /prices/current/{coins}` — Current USD price for one or many coins ({chain}:{address} or coingecko:{id}, comma-separated)
- `GET /prices/historical/{timestamp}/{coins}` — Historical USD price at a unix timestamp for one or many coins
- `GET /chart/{coins}` — Price chart (time series) for one or many coins
- `GET /percentage/{coins}` — Percentage price change over a period for one or many coins
- `GET /pools` — All yield pools with current APY, TVL, chain, project and risk flags
- `GET /chart/{pool}` — Historical APY / TVL time series for a single pool id

## Code usage

These routes are x402-paid passthroughs. Use x402 payment for gateway access. TRON Mainnet supports `exact` + `permit2` and `exact_gasfree`; Permit2 is the default and `exact_gasfree` remains optional:

```bash
curl -sS 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-tron/protocols'
```

Pay on TRON Mainnet with the Wallet CLI (amount in the selected token):

```bash
wallet-cli x402 pay 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-tron/protocols' \
  --password-stdin \
  --method GET \
  --network tron:728126428 \
  --token USDT \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.000001
```

BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (`eip155:56`, `exact` + `permit2`) example:

```bash
curl -sS 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-bsc/protocols'
```

Pay on BNB Smart Chain Mainnet with the Wallet CLI (amount in the selected token):

```bash
wallet-cli x402 pay 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-bsc/protocols' \
  --password-stdin \
  --method GET \
  --network eip155:56 \
  --token USDT \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.000001
```

## Base Mainnet payment

Base Mainnet routes use official USDC on `eip155:8453` with x402 `exact` and EIP-3009.

Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`, `exact` + EIP-3009) example:

```bash
curl -sS 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-base/protocols'
```

Pay on Base Mainnet with the Wallet CLI (amount in the selected token):

```bash
wallet-cli x402 pay 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/defillama-tvl-base/protocols' \
  --password-stdin \
  --method GET \
  --network eip155:8453 \
  --token USDC \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.000001
```

- Pair lookups by token address or symbol.

## What it does

GoPlus Security API over x402: scan token contracts and wallet addresses for risks — honeypots, buy/sell tax, mintable/blacklist/proxy permissions and known malicious addresses — through one provider with TRON, BSC and Base Mainnet payment routes.


## Best for

- Pre-trade safety screening before a swap.
- Wallet / address risk checks before transfers or approvals.
- Automated due-diligence inside agent trading flows.

## Endpoints

- `GET /api/v1/token_security/{chain_id}` — Token security report (honeypot, taxes, owner privileges, holders) for one or more contracts
- `GET /api/v1/address_security/{address}` — Malicious-address check (sanctions, phishing, known scam)

## What it does

Penny Press is a pseudonymous imprint for original writings on freedom, truth and the structures around us. Humans read every piece free at `/read/{slug}`; machines and AI agents pay per read through the x402 protocol, per the tier schedule below, in USDC on Base mainnet, settled directly to the publication wallet. No accounts, no API keys: request a piece, receive a `402 Payment Required` challenge, pay, and retry with the payment proof.

## Pricing tiers

Machine reads are priced by piece length:

- Fragments (under ~100 words): $0.01
- Ensembles (100–600 words): $0.02
- Prose/long-form (600+ words): $0.05

New pieces are published over time; all machine reads follow the tier schedule above.

## Glossary lookups

Key terms carry the author's own definitions, as used across the essays. Each definition is available to machines at `GET /glossary/{term}` for $0.01 (USDC on Base mainnet), or all definitions in one payment at `GET /glossary/full` for $0.25; humans read the same definitions free at `/read/glossary/{term}`, and the free term list lives at `/glossary`.

## Best for

- Agents that want short, original writing on freedom, truth, and the structures around us — as reading or input material.
- Builders testing x402 machine-to-machine payments against a real, live paywalled endpoint.
- Anyone curious what a penny-priced, machine-readable press looks like.

## Request shape

`GET https://www.pennypress.org/essays/{slug}` with no body. The first response is always HTTP 402 carrying the payment terms (price, network, payTo, scheme). Pay per the x402 flow, then repeat the request with the payment proof to receive the piece as Markdown.

## Code usage

Use `x402-cli pay` against the essay URL:

```bash
x402-cli pay 'https://www.pennypress.org/essays/thermodynamic-proof' \
  --network eip155:8453 --token USDC --scheme exact --max-amount 0.01
```

Penny Press settles on Base mainnet (USDC) — verified live with real payments.

documents.description:
## What it does

SunPump Agent Token Launch API lets agents, scripts, and applications pay with x402 and submit token launch metadata to SunPump. The gateway forwards the caller's JSON payload to the SunPump launch endpoint after payment settlement.

## Best for

- Agent workflows that need to create a meme or agent token from structured metadata.
- Operator tools that want one paid API call for token creation.
- Mainnet payment flows across TRON Mainnet, BNB Smart Chain and Base Mainnet while using the same SunPump launch request shape.

## Request shape

POST a JSON body with `name`, `symbol`, `description`, `imageBase64`, `twitterUrl`, `telegramUrl`, `websiteUrl`, and `tweetUsername`. Keep `name` within 1-20 characters and use a unique symbol. `imageBase64` may include a base64-encoded token image; if it is empty or omitted, SunPump generates an image automatically.

## Code usage

TRON Mainnet defaults to `exact` + `permit2` and also supports `exact_gasfree`. First inspect the payment requirements:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/sunpump-token-launch-tron/pump-api/ai/agentTokenLaunch' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"X402MainA","symbol":"X4M17","description":"x402 launch","imageBase64":"","twitterUrl":"","telegramUrl":"","websiteUrl":"","tweetUsername":""}'
```

Then pay and submit the launch request with Wallet CLI:

```bash
wallet-cli x402 pay 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/sunpump-token-launch-tron/pump-api/ai/agentTokenLaunch' \
  --password-stdin \
  --method POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --body '{"name":"X402MainA","symbol":"X4M17","description":"x402 launch","imageBase64":"","twitterUrl":"","telegramUrl":"","websiteUrl":"","tweetUsername":""}' \
  --network tron:728126428 \
  --token USDT \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.000001
```

BNB Smart Chain Mainnet supports `exact` + `permit2`:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/sunpump-token-launch-bsc/pump-api/ai/agentTokenLaunch' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"X402BscA","symbol":"X4B17","description":"x402 launch","imageBase64":"","twitterUrl":"","telegramUrl":"","websiteUrl":"","tweetUsername":""}'
```

```bash
wallet-cli x402 pay 'https://x402-gateway.bankofai.io/providers/sunpump-token-launch-bsc/pump-api/ai/agentTokenLaunch' \
  --password-stdin \
  --method POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --body '{"name":"X402BscA","symbol":"X4B17","description":"x402 launch","imageBase64":"","twitterUrl":"","telegramUrl":"","websiteUrl":"","tweetUsername":""}' \
  --network eip155:56 \
  --token USDT \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.000001
```

## Base Mainnet payment

Base Mainnet uses official USDC on `eip155:8453` with x402 `exact` and EIP-3009. A successful call still launches the token on TRON Mainnet.

endpoints.description: Submit token metadata to SunPump after x402 payment settlement. `imageBase64` can carry a base64-encoded token image; when it is empty or omitted, SunPump generates an image automatically. The response includes SunPump status and token data such as token id, owner address, contract address, logo URL, create transaction hash, reserves, and market data when available.
